title: Complete JavaScript Mastery
description: Master JavaScript from zero to hero. Learn ES6+, async programming, closures, prototypes, and build real-world projects. This comprehensive course covers everything you need to become a proficient JavaScript developer.

title: React & Next.js Pro
description: Build production-ready React applications with Next.js. Learn hooks, state management, server-side rendering, API routes, and deployment strategies used by top companies.

title: Node.js Backend Development
description: Learn to build scalable backend APIs with Node.js and Express. Covers REST APIs, authentication, database integration, testing, and deployment to production environments.

title: TailwindCSS Design Systems
description: Create beautiful, responsive UIs with TailwindCSS. Learn utility-first CSS, component patterns, custom themes, animations, and how to build a complete design system from scratch.

title: Full-Stack TypeScript
description: End-to-end TypeScript development. Master types, generics, decorators, and build full-stack applications with TypeScript on both frontend and backend for maximum type safety.

title: DevOps & Cloud Deployment
description: Deploy like a pro. Learn Docker, CI/CD pipelines, AWS/GCP basics, monitoring, and infrastructure as code. Everything you need to ship your applications with confidence.
